senses.en: to treat a place with fumes to kill pests or germs

example.en: The warehouse was fumigated to get rid of insects.
example.zh: 仓库经过熏蒸以消灭害虫。

senses.en: a cheap hard building board made from compressed wood fibers

example.en: The back of the bookshelf is made of thin hardboard.
example.zh: 书架的背板是用薄硬质纤维板做的。

senses.en: to give someone a task or duty to do

example.en: The teacher assigned each group a short presentation.
example.zh: 老师给每个小组布置了一个简短的展示。

senses.en: to officially choose someone for a job, role, or place

example.en: The manager assigned her to the new project.
example.zh: 经理派她参与这个新项目。

senses.en: to give a particular value, meaning, or use to something

example.en: The program assigns a number to each record.
example.zh: 该程序给每条记录分配一个编号。

senses.en: a line that marks the edge of an area or separates two places

example.en: The river forms the boundary between the two countries.
example.zh: 这条河构成两国之间的边界。

senses.en: the limit of what is acceptable, possible, or known

example.en: Scientists are pushing the boundaries of what is possible.
example.zh: 科学家正在拓展可能性的界限。

senses.en: for a structure, to fall down or break apart suddenly

example.en: The old roof collapsed under the weight of the snow.
example.zh: 旧屋顶在雪的重压下倒塌了。

senses.en: to fail or stop working suddenly

example.en: The peace talks collapsed after several hours.
example.zh: 和平谈判几小时后破裂了。

senses.en: a sudden fall or failure

example.en: The collapse of the old bridge blocked the road.
example.zh: 旧桥倒塌堵塞了道路。

senses.en: for a person, to fall down suddenly, often because of weakness or illness

example.en: He collapsed after running in the heat.
example.zh: 他在炎热天气中跑步后倒下了。

senses.en: to suffer something painful or difficult patiently

example.en: She endured the pain without complaining.
example.zh: 她忍受着疼痛，没有抱怨。

senses.en: to face and withstand something difficult with courage

example.en: The small town endured the storm and rebuilt.
example.zh: 这个小镇经受住了暴风雨并重建家园。

senses.en: to continue to exist for a long time

example.en: The ancient bridge has endured for centuries.
example.zh: 这座古桥已经屹立了数百年。

senses.en: good enough; satisfactory

example.en: The hotel was decent for the price.
example.zh: 就这个价格来说，这家酒店还不错。

senses.en: kind, fair and respectable

example.en: He is a decent man who always helps his neighbors.
example.zh: 他是个正派的人，总是帮助邻居。

senses.en: socially acceptable; not causing embarrassment

example.en: Please wear decent clothes to the ceremony.
example.zh: 请穿着得体的衣服参加典礼。

senses.en: to disappear suddenly and completely

example.en: The magician made the rabbit vanish.
example.zh: 魔术师让兔子消失了。

senses.en: the act of stopping something bad from happening

example.en: Regular exercise is important for the prevention of heart disease.
example.zh: 经常锻炼对预防心脏病很重要。

senses.en: a written or printed announcement giving information

example.en: There was a notice on the door saying the shop was closed.
example.zh: 门上有一张通知，说商店关门了。

senses.en: attention given to something

example.en: She took no notice of the warning.
example.zh: 她没有理会那个警告。

senses.en: to see or become aware of something

example.en: I noticed a small mistake in the report.
example.zh: 我注意到报告里有一个小错误。

senses.en: wide from one side to the other

example.en: The river is broad here.
example.zh: 这条河在这里很宽。

senses.en: covering a wide range or scope

example.en: The course covers a broad range of subjects.
example.zh: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题。

senses.en: the ability to notice or become aware of something through the senses

example.en: Her perception of the sound changed as she moved closer.
example.zh: 随着她靠近，她对那个声音的感知发生了变化。

senses.en: a particular way of understanding or thinking about something

example.en: The report challenged common perceptions of the issue.
example.zh: 该报告挑战了人们对这个问题的普遍看法。

senses.en: the act of delivering or sharing something among people or places

example.en: The distribution of food to local families began at noon.
example.zh: 向当地家庭分发食物的活动在中午开始。

senses.en: the way something is spread or arranged over an area

example.en: The map shows the distribution of rainfall across the region.
example.zh: 这张地图显示了该地区降雨的分布情况。

senses.en: a set of values showing how often something occurs

example.en: The class compared the distribution of test scores.
example.zh: 全班比较了考试成绩的分布情况。

senses.en: fully in agreement; agreed by everyone

example.en: The committee made a unanimous decision to approve the plan.
example.zh: 委员会一致决定批准该计划。

senses.en: a panel with screens and controls used to operate or monitor a computer or other system

example.en: The administrator entered the commands into the server console.
example.zh: 管理员在服务器控制台上输入了这些命令。

senses.en: a small table or cabinet fixed against a wall

example.en: She placed the vase on the console in the hallway.
example.zh: 她把花瓶放在走廊的壁桌上。

senses.en: to comfort someone who is sad or upset

example.en: Friends came to console her after the bad news.
example.zh: 坏消息传来后，朋友们前来安慰她。

senses.en: serious, formal, and dignified in manner or atmosphere

example.en: The ceremony had a solemn atmosphere.
example.zh: 仪式气氛庄严。

senses.en: done or made in a formal and sincere way

example.en: He made a solemn vow to support her.
example.zh: 他郑重发誓会支持她。

senses.en: not fair or sensible; not showing good judgment

example.en: It is unreasonable to expect her to finish all this work in one day.
example.zh: 指望她一天内完成所有这些工作是不合理的。

senses.en: beyond what is normal or acceptable in amount or degree

example.en: The hotel charges an unreasonable price for a single room.
example.zh: 这家酒店对一个单间收取过高的价格。

senses.en: the process of burning; a chemical reaction with oxygen that produces heat and light

example.en: The engine converts fuel into energy through internal combustion.
example.zh: 发动机通过内燃将燃料转化为能量。

senses.en: too proud of your own appearance or abilities

example.en: She is vain about her looks and checks the mirror often.
example.zh: 她对自己的外表很自负，经常照镜子。

senses.en: producing no result; useless

example.en: They made a vain attempt to save the business.
example.zh: 他们为挽救公司做出了徒劳的尝试。

senses.en: any one of a set; no matter which one
senses.zh: 无论哪一个；（那些中）随便哪一个

example.en: Take whichever you like.
example.zh: 随便你喜欢哪个就拿哪个。

collocations: whichever way you look at it

senses.en: used before a noun to mean any one of a set, no matter which

example.en: Whichever route we choose, we will arrive late.
example.zh: 无论我们选哪条路线，都会晚到。

senses.en: a large crowd of people

example.en: A throng of fans waited outside the stadium.
example.zh: 一大群球迷在体育场外等候。

senses.en: to gather or fill a place in large numbers

example.en: Thousands thronged the streets to watch the parade.
example.zh: 成千上万的人涌上街头观看游行。

senses.en: very clever and original in design or thinking

example.en: She found an ingenious way to fix the broken shelf.
example.zh: 她找到了一个巧妙的办法来修理坏掉的架子。

senses.en: a weighted rod that swings freely from a fixed point, especially one that regulates a clock

example.en: The pendulum of the old clock swung back and forth.
example.zh: 旧时钟的钟摆来回摆动。

senses.en: a situation or opinion that changes repeatedly between two opposite positions
senses.zh: 摇摆不定的局面；钟摆式摇摆

example.en: Public opinion often swings like a pendulum between optimism and doubt.
example.zh: 公众舆论常像钟摆一样在乐观与怀疑之间摇摆。

senses.en: relating to a tribe or tribes

example.en: The tribal elders gathered to discuss the matter.
example.zh: 部落的长老们聚在一起讨论这件事。

senses.en: involving strong loyalty within a group and hostility toward outsiders

example.en: Politics has become increasingly tribal in recent years.
example.zh: 近年来政治变得越来越部落化。

senses.en: (commerce, dated) free of charge to the buyer, with transport costs paid by the seller
senses.zh: （商业术语，旧式）费用由卖方承担的，免费的

example.en: The goods were delivered franco to the warehouse.
example.zh: 货物以免运费方式送到仓库。

senses.en: to cut something with a sweeping movement or reduce it greatly

example.en: The company slashed prices to attract more customers.
example.zh: 公司大幅降价以吸引更多顾客。

senses.en: a long deep cut, or the / punctuation mark

example.en: There was a long slash on the wooden door.
example.zh: 木门上有一道长长的砍痕。

senses.en: a smaller group formed from a committee to deal with a particular task
senses.zh: 小组委员会；委员会下设小组

example.en: The safety subcommittee will review the new rules next week.
example.zh: 安全小组委员会将于下周审查新规定。

senses.en: a small brass horn without valves, used for military calls

example.en: A soldier played reveille on the bugle at dawn.
example.zh: 黎明时分，一名士兵用军号吹响了起床号。

senses.en: to play a bugle

example.en: The bugler bugled the retreat signal.
example.zh: 号手吹响了撤退的信号。

senses.en: a large region of islands in the Pacific Ocean, including Melanesia, Micronesia and Polynesia, often together with Australia and New Zealand

example.en: Australia is the largest country in Oceania.
example.zh: 澳大利亚是大洋洲最大的国家。

senses.en: used to give a negative reply or refusal

example.en: Do you want more coffee? No, thank you.
example.zh: 你还想再来点咖啡吗？不用了，谢谢。

senses.en: not any; not one

example.en: There is no milk left in the fridge.
example.zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

senses.en: an answer or vote that refuses or rejects something

example.en: The proposal received ten noes in the vote.
example.zh: 该提案在表决中获得了十张反对票。

senses.en: used on signs or in rules to say that something is not allowed

example.en: No smoking is allowed in this building.
example.zh: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。

senses.en: many times; frequently

example.en: I often walk to work when the weather is nice.
example.zh: 天气好的时候我经常步行上班。

senses.en: works; pieces of art, literature or music (plural of work)

example.en: Her collected works were published last year.
example.zh: 她的作品集于去年出版。

senses.en: a factory or industrial plant

example.en: The steel works employs over a thousand people.
example.zh: 这家钢铁厂雇用一千多名员工。

senses.en: the moving parts of a machine or clock; the mechanism

example.en: The works of the old watch are still precise.
example.zh: 这块旧手表的机件仍然精准。

senses.en: (informal, usually 'the works') everything available or everything done thoroughly

example.en: They ordered pizza with the works.
example.zh: 他们点了加全套配料的比萨。

senses.en: a country in southern Europe, on the Italian Peninsula

example.en: Italy is famous for its pasta, pizza and art.
example.zh: 意大利以意面、披萨和艺术闻名。

senses.en: a short crowbar used for forcing things open

example.en: The locksmith kept a jimmy in his toolbox.
example.zh: 锁匠的工具箱里放着一把撬棍。

senses.en: to force open (a door, window, or lock) using a lever or crowbar

example.en: Someone tried to jimmy the lock on the back door.
example.zh: 有人试图撬开后门的锁。

senses.en: the act of consuming liquids

example.en: Drinking plenty of water is good for your health.
example.zh: 多喝水对健康有益。

senses.en: the habit of drinking alcohol, especially to excess

example.en: His drinking started to affect his work.
example.zh: 他的酗酒开始影响他的工作。

senses.en: to lower someone's dignity or worth, often with words

example.en: His rude comments demeaned his coworkers.
example.zh: 他的粗鲁言论贬低了同事们。

senses.en: a substance that kills germs and prevents infection

example.en: The nurse cleaned the cut with antiseptic.
example.zh: 护士用消毒剂清洗了伤口。

senses.en: free from germs; extremely clean, often in a cold or impersonal way
senses.zh: 无菌的；洁净得缺乏生气的

example.en: The hospital room felt cold and antiseptic.
example.zh: 病房让人感觉冰冷且毫无生气。

senses.en: in an irregular or unequal way; not smoothly or equally

example.en: The paint dried unevenly on the wall.
example.zh: 墙上的油漆干得不均匀。

senses.en: soft, fine hair or fluffy fibers

example.en: The peach was covered in soft fuzz.
example.zh: 那桃子表面覆盖着一层细软的绒毛。

senses.en: shaped like a cone

example.en: The tent had a conical shape with a pointed top.
example.zh: 帐篷呈圆锥形，顶部尖尖的。

senses.en: to shout rude or mocking remarks at someone

example.en: The crowd jeered at the losing team.
example.zh: 人群嘲笑了落败的球队。

senses.en: a mocking or rude remark

example.en: His speech was met with jeers from the audience.
example.zh: 他的演讲遭到观众的嘲笑。

senses.en: to settle oneself comfortably in a place

example.en: He ensconced himself in an armchair by the fire.
example.zh: 他在炉边的扶手椅里舒舒服服地安顿下来。

senses.en: a shiny metal, or chromium used as a plating

example.en: The bike's chrome shone in the sun.
example.zh: 自行车上的镀铬件在阳光下闪闪发光。

senses.en: to coat something with chromium

example.en: The shop chromed the motorcycle parts.
example.zh: 这家店给摩托车零件镀铬。

senses.en: to place one thing over another so both can be seen

example.en: The software lets you superimpose text on photos.
example.zh: 这款软件可以让你在照片上叠加文字。

senses.en: military weapons, ammunition, and supplies

example.en: The factory produced munitions during the war.
example.zh: 战争期间这家工厂生产军火。

senses.en: the rules for arranging words into sentences in a language

example.en: English syntax usually puts the verb after the subject.
example.zh: 英语句法通常把动词放在主语之后。

senses.en: a performance of a play or film held in the afternoon

example.en: We bought tickets for the Saturday matinee.
example.zh: 我们买了周六日场的票。

senses.en: to give money for goods, work, or a debt

example.en: I paid the driver in cash.
example.zh: 我用现金付给了司机。

senses.en: money received for work

example.en: The job offers good pay and flexible hours.
example.zh: 这份工作工资不错，时间也灵活。

senses.en: to bring a benefit or profit

example.en: Learning a language can pay off in the long run.
example.zh: 学习一门语言从长远看会有回报。

senses.en: to suffer a penalty or consequence

example.en: He paid dearly for that mistake.
example.zh: 他为那个错误付出了惨重代价。

senses.en: the way someone or something moves or faces

example.en: The car turned in the direction of the station.
example.zh: 汽车朝车站的方向转弯。

senses.en: instructions about how to do something or get somewhere

example.en: The teacher gave clear directions for the task.
example.zh: 老师为这项任务给出了清楚的指示。

senses.en: control or guidance of an activity

example.en: The project was under her direction.
example.zh: 这个项目由她指导。

senses.en: the ability to know where you are or where to go

example.en: She has a good sense of direction.
example.zh: 她的方向感很好。

senses.en: Used to introduce a condition or supposition.

example.en: If it rains, we will stay inside.
example.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在室内。

senses.en: Used to introduce an indirect question or uncertainty.

example.en: I don't know if she will come.
example.zh: 我不知道她是否会来。

senses.en: A condition or possibility that must be considered.

example.en: A quick recovery is still a big if.
example.zh: 能否很快康复仍是个很大的未知数。

senses.en: a copy of something, or a simplified representation used to show how it looks or works
senses.zh: 模型；用于展示外观或运作方式的简化表示

example.en: He built a model of the ship.
example.zh: 他制作了一个船的模型。

senses.en: a person or thing that is a good example to follow
senses.zh: 值得效仿的人或事物；榜样

example.en: She is a role model for young athletes.
example.zh: 她是年轻运动员的榜样。

senses.en: to wear clothes in order to display them

example.en: She models for a fashion brand.
example.zh: 她为一个时尚品牌做模特。

senses.en: a person whose job is to wear clothes for photographs or fashion shows

example.en: The model wore a blue jacket in the photograph.
example.zh: 照片中的模特穿着一件蓝色夹克。

senses.en: a device that records sound or video

example.en: She used a recorder to tape the lecture.
example.zh: 她用录音机把讲座录了下来。

senses.en: a person who keeps official records

example.en: The town recorder keeps all official documents.
example.zh: 镇的记录员保管所有官方文件。

senses.en: a small flute-like musical instrument played by blowing into the end

example.en: Students learn to play the recorder in music class.
example.zh: 学生们在音乐课上学习吹竖笛。

senses.en: to stick firmly to a surface

example.en: The sticker would not adhere to the wet surface.
example.zh: 这张贴纸粘不到潮湿的表面上。

senses.en: to follow rules, beliefs, or plans closely

example.en: All employees must adhere to the company's safety rules.
example.zh: 所有员工都必须遵守公司的安全规定。

senses.en: a machine with blades that spins using moving liquid or gas to produce power

example.en: The power plant uses steam turbines to generate electricity.
example.zh: 这家发电厂用蒸汽涡轮机发电。

senses.en: proof or evidence that something is true or correct

example.en: The test results provided confirmation of the diagnosis.
example.zh: 检测结果证实了该诊断。

senses.en: an official statement or message agreeing to or verifying something, such as a booking or appointment

example.en: You will receive a confirmation email once your booking is complete.
example.zh: 预订完成后，您将收到一封确认邮件。

senses.en: formal approval or ratification of something, e.g. an appointment or agreement

example.en: The treaty awaits confirmation by the parliament.
example.zh: 该条约尚待议会批准。

senses.en: the ability to move or be moved freely and easily

example.en: Regular exercise helps improve mobility in older adults.
example.zh: 经常锻炼有助于改善老年人的活动能力。

senses.en: the ability to move between jobs, social classes, or places

example.en: Higher education can increase social mobility.
example.zh: 高等教育可以提高社会流动性。

senses.en: to state something clearly and firmly as true

example.en: She affirmed her belief in the project's success.
example.zh: 她肯定地表示她相信这个项目会成功。

senses.en: to confirm or uphold a decision, often in law

example.en: The court affirmed the lower court's decision.
example.zh: 法院维持了下级法院的判决。

senses.en: the ability to say clever, funny things

example.en: She entertained the guests with her quick wit.
example.zh: 她以机敏的妙语逗乐了客人。

senses.en: intelligence and good judgment; mental ability

example.en: Use your wits to solve the puzzle.
example.zh: 动动脑筋来解开这个谜题。

senses.en: very strong sexual desire

example.en: In the story, lust leads the hero to ruin.
example.zh: 在故事中，色欲导致主人公走向毁灭。

senses.en: a very strong desire for something such as money or power

example.en: His lust for power never faded.
example.zh: 他对权力的贪欲从未消退。

senses.en: to have a very strong desire for something or someone (lust after/for)

example.en: He lusted after a life of luxury.
example.zh: 他渴望过上奢华的生活。

senses.en: a long story about a family or hero over many years
senses.zh: 长篇传奇故事；家族史诗

example.en: The novel is a saga spanning three generations of one family.
example.zh: 这部小说是一个横跨一个家族三代人的长篇传奇。

senses.en: a long series of events, often complicated or annoying
senses.zh: 一连串事件；冗长波折的经过

example.en: The whole saga of moving house took nearly six months.
example.zh: 搬家的整个波折过程花了将近六个月。

senses.en: a reference work with articles on many subjects

example.en: She looked up the planet in an encyclopedia.
example.zh: 她在百科全书里查了那颗行星。

collocations: look it up in an encyclopedia

senses.en: done together by two or more people or groups

example.en: The countries made a concerted effort to reduce pollution.
example.zh: 这些国家共同努力减少污染。

senses.en: slightly brown in color

example.en: The leaves turned brownish in late summer.
example.zh: 夏末叶子变成了浅褐色。

senses.en: coming next after forty-nine in order; 50th

example.en: The town celebrated its fiftieth anniversary last year.
example.zh: 该镇去年庆祝了建镇五十周年。

senses.en: one of fifty equal parts

example.en: One fiftieth of the total budget was spent on advertising.
example.zh: 总预算的五十分之一用于广告。

senses.en: a person who makes or repairs shoes

example.en: The shoemaker repaired the torn heel within an hour.
example.zh: 鞋匠一小时内就把破损的鞋跟修好了。

senses.en: a group of three closely related people or things

example.en: The band's famous trinity of singer, guitarist, and drummer reunited on stage.
example.zh: 乐队著名的歌手、吉他手和鼓手三人组合在舞台上重聚了。

senses.en: (Trinity) in Christianity, the union of Father, Son, and Holy Spirit as one God

example.en: The Trinity is a central doctrine in Christian theology.
example.zh: 三位一体是基督教神学的核心教义。

senses.en: to tremble or shake, especially in the voice

example.en: Her voice quavered as she spoke about the accident.
example.zh: 她谈起那次事故时声音发颤。

senses.en: a trembling sound in the voice

example.en: There was a quaver in his voice when he said goodbye.
example.zh: 他道别时声音里带着一丝颤抖。

senses.en: a musical note equal to half a beat in common time; an eighth note

example.en: The melody is made up of quavers and semiquavers.
example.zh: 这段旋律由八分音符和十六分音符组成。

senses.en: a female lion

example.en: The lioness hunted quietly through the tall grass.
example.zh: 母狮悄悄地穿过高草捕猎。

senses.en: easily annoyed and bad-tempered
